cards.name: Feral Chihuahua

cards.name: Firework Dad
cards.text: Rotate: Deal 1 damage to another of your Characters. If it survives, it gets +2 Power this turn.

cards.name: Bachelorette Party
cards.flavor: Matching shirts. Conflicting alibis.

cards.name: Unsupervised Toddler

cards.name: Road Rage Ron

cards.name: Scout With a Flare Gun
cards.text: Rotate: Deal 1 damage to a Character. If it is one of your Daredevils, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Pool Pirate
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, Draw a card.

cards.name: Pirate With No Exit Strategy
cards.flavor: The treasure map ends at the tow yard.

cards.name: Guy Who Definitely Read the Instructions
cards.text: When this enters play, deal 2 damage to another of your Characters or to your Leader.

cards.name: Fourth of July Showrunner
cards.text: When this enters play, deal 1 damage to each of your other Characters. Draw a card for each that survives, up to 3. When this attacks, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader for each of your damaged Characters.

cards.name: Giga Chad
cards.flavor: Even his warm-up has a warm-up.

cards.name: Florida Man's Cousin
cards.flavor: The family keeps him off the news with a spelling change.

cards.name: Guy Who Brought His Own Ramp
cards.text: When this attacks, you may Rotate another of your Ready Characters. If you do, this gets +3 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: Jet Ski Mechanic
cards.text: Rotate, Dismiss one of your Items: One of your Characters gets +3 Power this turn.

cards.name: Porch Pirate
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: Free shipping. For him.

cards.name: Vape Kid
cards.text: When this enters play, you may deal 1 damage to your Leader. If you do, Draw a card, then Discard a card.
cards.flavor: The cloud has entered the group chat.

cards.name: Minibike Menace
cards.text: Hothead. When this attacks, you may deal 1 damage to each of your other Characters. This gets +1 Power for this Attack for each Character damaged this way.

cards.name: Hold My Beer
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to one of your Characters. It gets +3 Power this turn.

cards.name: Send It!
cards.text: One of your Characters gets +3 Power and -1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Glory Days
cards.text: Ready one of your Rotated Characters that attacked this turn. It gets +2 Power this turn and cannot Attack again this turn.
cards.flavor: The story gets faster every year.

cards.name: No, I'm Fine
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Deal 1 damage to your Leader.

cards.name: Fireworks Incident
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and an opposing Character. Deal 2 damage to each. If your Character survives, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Commit to the Bit
cards.text: One of your Ready Characters gets +4 Power this turn and skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: Floor It!
cards.text: Choose one of your Rotated Characters. Ready it and deal 2 damage to it. It gains Hothead this turn.

cards.name: Walk It Off
cards.text: Heal 2 damage from a Character. Draw a card.

cards.name: Gas Station Pills
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Power. Dismiss this: Ready the attached Character and deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Roman Candle
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Rotate: Deal 1 damage to an opposing Character. If the attached Character is not a Scout, deal 1 damage to it too.

cards.name: Hot Potato
cards.text: When this enters play, place it beside the opposing Leader. Either player may Activate this while it is beside their Leader. Rotate one of your Ready Characters: Move this beside the other Leader. At end of turn, deal 1 damage to the Leader beside this, then Return this to its Owner's hand.

cards.name: Homemade Launch Ramp
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. When it attacks, you may Dismiss this. If you do, it gets +3 Power for this Attack. After the Attack, deal 1 damage to it.

cards.name: Wedding Cover Band
cards.flavor: We take requests. Mostly to turn it down.

cards.name: Wedding DJ
cards.text: Your other Musicians get +1 Power.

cards.name: Karaoke Champion
cards.text: Whenever you play an Action, this gets +1 Power this turn.

cards.name: Jam Band Hippie
cards.text: When you Play your third card in a Round, heal 2 damage from one of your Characters.

cards.name: Youth Pastor With a Guitar
cards.flavor: Three chords. Forty-seven announcements.

cards.name: Stage Mom
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +1 Power this turn. When you Play your second card in a Round, you may give one of your Parent or Kid Characters +1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Reunion Tour Drummer
cards.text: Stack. When this attacks while stacked, it gets +2 Power for this Attack.
cards.flavor: The band said they were getting everybody back together.

cards.name: Mike
cards.flavor: Mike.

cards.name: Social Media Influencer
cards.text: Rotate: Draw a card, then Discard a card. If you Played at least two cards this turn, you may give another of your Characters +2 Power this turn.

cards.name: Boss Babe
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Character costing 2 or less and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Overenthusiastic Softball Mom
cards.text: Rotate: Ready another of your Rotated Characters that attacked this turn. It cannot Attack again this turn. If it is a Kid, it gets +2 Guard this turn. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Peaked in High School
cards.text: The first time each turn you Play a Character after Playing another card, that Character gets +1 Power and +1 Guard this turn.
cards.flavor: He still calls the principal “Coach.”

cards.name: Little Leaguer
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: The scouting report just says “sugar.”

cards.name: Clown Who Booked the Wrong Gig
cards.flavor: The invitation said “bring something for the grill.”

cards.name: Basic White Girl
cards.flavor: The itinerary is mostly iced coffee.

cards.name: Single Dad
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +2 Guard this turn. If that Character is a Kid, heal 1 damage from it.

cards.name: Cookie Scout
cards.text: When this enters play, Draw a card, then Discard a card. If you Played another card this turn, this gets +1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Roadie Who Never Left
cards.text: Whenever you play an Action, this gets +1 Power this turn. After your third Action each turn, you may play a Character costing 3 or less from your hand for free.

cards.name: Reply All
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Your opponent draws 1.
cards.flavor: You do not need to be on this thread.

cards.name: Roll Call
cards.text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Carpool
cards.text: Return one of your Characters to your hand. The next Character you Play this turn costs 1 less.

cards.name: Encore!
cards.text: Choose an Action in your discard costing 1 or less. You may Play it without paying its Cost. If you do, put it on the bottom of your deck instead of into your discard.

cards.name: One More Song
cards.text: Draw a card.

cards.name: Everybody Bats
cards.text: Choose up to three of your Characters. Each gets +1 Power this turn. If you chose three, Draw a card.

cards.name: Bring a Friend
cards.text: The next Character you play this turn costs 2 less.

cards.name: Parking Lot Pep Talk
cards.text: A Character gets +1 Power and +2 Guard this turn. If it is a Parent, Kid, Musician, or Clown, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Participation Trophy
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. When you Play your second card in a Round, the attached Character gets +1 Power this turn.

cards.name: Orange Slices
cards.text: Dismiss this: Heal 2 damage from a Character, or 3 damage if you Played another card this turn.

cards.name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
cards.text: Rotate: One of your Characters gets +1 Power this turn. If you Played another card this turn and that Character is a Musician or Clown, it gets +2 Power instead.

cards.name: Starter Kit
cards.text: When this enters play, Draw a card, then Discard a card. Dismiss this: The next Character costing 2 or less you Play this turn costs 1 less.

cards.name: Assistant Magician
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return another of your Characters to your hand. If you do, Draw a card.

cards.name: Birthday Kid Who Knows the Trick
cards.text: While this is in your hand, when one of your cards reveals it, you may put it on the bottom of your deck if it is still in your hand. If you do, Draw a card. When this enters play, look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Alien Abduction Victim
cards.text: Cloak.
cards.flavor: Missed three hours. Still got charged for parking.

cards.name: Street Magician
cards.text: When this enters play, choose an opposing Character. Its owner may Return it to their hand. If they do not, Rotate it.

cards.name: Escape Artist
cards.text: When this enters play, you may return another of your Characters to your hand.

cards.name: Off-Duty Clown
cards.text: Cloak. The first time each turn one of your effects Returns another of your Characters from play to your hand, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Kid With an iPad
cards.text: When this enters play, an opposing Character gets -1 Power this turn.
cards.flavor: The battery is at one percent. So is everyone’s patience.

cards.name: Social Media Grifter
cards.text: Rotate: Draw 2 cards, then Discard 2 cards. If one of your cards revealed a card from your hand this turn, Discard 1 card instead.

cards.name: Conspiracy Blogger
cards.text: At the start of your first Turn each turn, name Character, Action, or Item. Reveal the top card of your deck. If you named its type, put it into your hand. Otherwise put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Tech Bro
cards.flavor: It’s a normal doorbell, but the subscription is mandatory.

cards.name: Coupon Scammer
cards.flavor: The expiration date is more of a suggestion.

cards.name: Neighborhood Group Admin
cards.flavor: Thirty-seven missed alerts. One unfamiliar sedan.

cards.name: IT Guy Who Quit Six Months Ago
cards.text: Rotate: Rotate an opposing Item. It cannot Activate abilities this turn.

cards.name: Identity Thief
cards.text: When this enters play, choose another Character with a printed Trait. This gains one of its printed Traits while this remains in play. Rotate: Choose another of your Characters. Draw a card, then Discard a card. If it shares a Trait with this, it gets +2 Power this turn.

cards.name: Pirate Radio Operator
cards.text: When this attacks, an opponent chooses one: this gets +2 Power for this Attack; or you Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Wi-Fi Bandit
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: Your password is his password.

cards.name: Script Kiddie
cards.text: Rotate: Choose an Item. If it is Ready, Rotate it. Otherwise, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Pirate With a Business License
cards.text: The first time each turn an opponent makes a choice instructed by one of your cards, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Pick a Card
cards.text: Present a card from your hand face down. An opponent guesses Character or not Character. Reveal it and keep it in your hand. If they guessed wrong, Draw 2 cards. Otherwise, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Now You See Me
cards.text: Return one of your Characters to your hand. Then you may Play a Character costing 2 or less from your hand by paying 1 less.

cards.name: Look Over There!
cards.text: Choose an opposing Character. It cannot block this turn.

cards.name: Wrong Address
cards.text: Choose two opposing Characters. Their owner chooses one of them. Return that Character to its owner's hand. If they have only one Character, choose and Return that Character instead.

cards.name: Terms and Conditions
cards.text: Choose an opposing Character. Its owner may Discard a card. If they do not, it gets -2 Power this turn.

cards.name: Default Password
cards.text: Choose an Item. If it is Ready, Rotate it. Otherwise, Draw a card. If you have a Hacker in play, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Have You Tried Turning It Off?
cards.text: Return a Rotated Item or Character to its owner's hand.

cards.name: Switcheroo
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and an opposing Character with equal or lower Cost. Return both to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Burner Phone
cards.text: Rotate, pay 1 Fuel: Draw a card, then put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Marked Deck
cards.text: Rotate: Look at the top card of your deck. You may put it on the bottom.

cards.name: Inconspicuous Bush
cards.text: When this enters play, you may put a Character costing 2 or less from your hand face down beneath this. When your Leader is Attacked, you may reveal and put it into play Ready before Blockers; it may Block if able. Its enters-play abilities do not trigger. At end of turn or if this leaves play, reveal and Return any hidden card to its Owner's hand.

cards.name: Spoofed Keycard
cards.text: Rotate: An opposing Character cannot Block this turn. If you have a Criminal or Pirate in play, it also gets -1 Power this turn.

cards.name: Scout Troop Quartermaster
cards.flavor: Prepared for everything except the inspection.

cards.name: General Contractor
cards.text: Rotate: Ready one of your Rotated Items. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Garage Inventor
cards.text: Rotate, Dismiss one of your Items: Draw 2 cards, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Dumpster Diver
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Item and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Doomsday Prepper
cards.flavor: End times. Curbside pickup.
cards.art_note: A backyard bunker stocked from curbside giveaways and salvaged supplies.

cards.name: Shopping Cart Knight
cards.flavor: Sir Carts-a-Lot yields to no curb.

cards.name: Junkyard Dog
cards.flavor: Beware of dog. Also tetanus.

cards.name: Raccoon of Unusual Size
cards.text: When this enters play, you may put an Item from your discard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, Draw a card. When this attacks, you may Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, this gets +2 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: Crazy Cat Lady
cards.text: Rotate: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order. If you revealed an Animal, heal 1 damage from one of your Characters.
cards.flavor: Every cat has a name. The neighbors have numbers.

cards.name: Wind-Up Toy
cards.text: Sucker Punch. When this attacks a Ready Character, this gets +1 Power for that Attack.
cards.flavor: No batteries required. No brakes included.

cards.name: Extension Cord Electrician
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Ready one of your Items. If you have another Builder in play, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Rat King
cards.text: Your other Animals get +1 Power.

cards.name: Possum in the Trash Can
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may Dismiss one of your Items. If you do, Return this from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Trash Palace Cockroach
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may put it from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Jailbroken Robot Vacuum
cards.text: Whenever you play an Item, tuck the top card of your deck beneath this. This gets +1 Power per tucked card. When this attacks, you may discard all tucked cards to deal that much damage to the opposing Leader.
cards.flavor: The knife attachment voided the warranty.

cards.name: Shopping Cart Golem
cards.text: Stack. When this is Defeated while stacked, Return its lower card from your discard to its Owner's hand.
cards.flavor: One wheel squeaks. One wheel seeks revenge.

cards.name: Curbside Mechanic
cards.text: When this enters play, you may Return an Item costing 1 from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Unlicensed Pool Guy
cards.text: The first Item you Play each turn costs 1 less. Rotate: Return an Item from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Scrounge
cards.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Item and put it into your hand. Put the rest into your discard.

cards.name: I Can Fix That
cards.text: Return an Item costing 1 from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Found This in the Garage
cards.text: Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. You may put an Item among them into your hand. Put the rest into your discard.

cards.name: That's Probably Still Good
cards.text: Heal 2 damage from a Character, or 3 damage if it is a Scavenger.

cards.name: Make It Work
cards.text: Dismiss one of your Items to draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Curb Alert
cards.text: Put an Item from your discard on the bottom of your deck. If you do, Draw a card.

cards.name: Don't Throw That Away
cards.text: Return an Item that entered your discard this turn to your hand.

cards.name: Good as New
cards.text: Choose a damaged Character. Heal all damage from it, then Rotate it.

cards.name: Duct Tape
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Guard. Rotate: Heal 1 damage from the attached Character, or 2 damage if it is a Construct.

cards.name: Zip Ties
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Dismiss this: The attached Character gets +2 Guard this turn, or +3 Guard if it is a Builder.

cards.name: Mystery Drawer of Cables
cards.text: When this enters play, draw a card. Dismiss this: Ready another of your Items.

cards.name: Used Ham Sandwich
cards.text: Dismiss this: Heal 2 damage from a Character. If it is a Scavenger, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Grumpy Old Guy
cards.text: When this Blocks, the attacker gets -1 Power for this Attack.

cards.name: HOA Enforcement Committee
cards.text: The first opposing Character to Attack your Leader each turn gets -1 Power for that Attack.

cards.name: Coupon Lady
cards.flavor: She has a binder. You have a problem.

cards.name: Mall Walker
cards.text: Rotate: Heal 2 damage from this or another of your Characters.

cards.name: Keyboard Warrior
cards.text: When another of your Characters Blocks, this gets +1 Power this turn.
cards.flavor: Brave enough to hit send.

cards.name: Crossing Guard
cards.text: Rotate: Another of your Characters gets +2 Guard this turn, or +3 Guard if it is a Kid.

cards.name: PTA President
cards.text: When this enters play, another of your Characters gets +2 Guard this turn. If it is a Parent or Kid, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Retired Marine Next Door
cards.flavor: Quiet neighborhood. Strict perimeter.

cards.name: HOA Vice President
cards.flavor: Vice is not silent.

cards.name: Linda From Neighborhood Watch
cards.text: When this Blocks, Draw a card, then Discard a card. Rotate: Another of your Characters gets +2 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Old Dog
cards.text: When this Blocks, you may give another of your Blocking Characters +2 temporary Guard for this Attack.

cards.name: Church Potluck Grandma
cards.text: Rotate: Heal 2 damage from one of your Characters or your Leader.

cards.name: Concrete Goose
cards.flavor: The association has approved its use of force.

cards.name: Church Usher
cards.text: When this enters play, you may give another of your Characters +1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Mall Cop
cards.text: This Character cannot Attack. While this is Ready, other Characters cannot use Hothead.
cards.flavor: No running.

cards.name: Tow-Truck Driver
cards.text: When this enters play, choose a Rotated opposing Character. Its owner may Discard a card. If they do not, that Character skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: HOA Lawyer
cards.text: The first time each turn an opposing Action that targeted one of your cards finishes resolving, its player may pay 1 Fuel. If they do not, they Discard a card. Rotate: Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Neighborhood Lifeguard
cards.text: Rotate: Choose an opposing Character. It gets -2 Power this turn, or -3 Power if its Power is greater than this Character’s Power.
cards.flavor: NO RUNNING includes whatever this is.

cards.name: File a Complaint
cards.text: Deal damage to an opposing Character equal to the number of Characters you control.

cards.name: Not in My Neighborhood
cards.text: Choose a Rotated opposing Character. Its owner may Discard a card. If they do not, it skips its next Ready step.

cards.name: Absolutely Not
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to an opposing Character.

cards.name: I Want to Speak to Your Manager
cards.text: Return an Item to its owner's hand. If it belongs to an opponent, they Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Read the Fine Print
cards.text: A Character gets -1 Power and -1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: 'Tis But a Scratch
cards.text: Heal 3 damage from your Leader. This costs 1 less if your Leader has less Health than the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Dig In
cards.text: Your Characters get +1 Guard this turn. If you have fewer Characters in play than an opponent, Draw a card.

cards.name: Wait Them Out
cards.text: Draw a card. If you have not attacked this turn, you may give one of your Characters +2 Guard this turn, or +3 Guard if it is an HOA Character.

cards.name: Security Camera
cards.text: Rotate: An opposing Character gets -1 Power this turn.

cards.name: Video Doorbell
cards.text: The first time each turn an opposing Character Attacks your Leader, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Occupied Stroller
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +2 Guard, or +3 Guard if it is a Parent or Kid. When the attached Character would take damage, you may Dismiss this to prevent 2 of that damage.
cards.flavor: The safest place in the neighborhood is behind it.

cards.name: Grandma's Cigarette Case
cards.text: The first time each turn one of your Characters survives damage, you may Dismiss this. If you do, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: First-Time Wrestler
cards.flavor: Signed the waiver in crayon.

cards.name: Florida Man's Stunt Double
cards.text: Hothead. When this is Defeated during an Attack, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Zombie Kid, Turtle Fan
cards.text: When this enters play, look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Animal or Undead Character and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in any order.

cards.name: Dumpster Zombie
cards.flavor: Taking “eat out of the trash” in a concerning direction.

cards.name: Retired Crash-Test Dummy
cards.text: When this enters play, you may deal 2 damage to it. If you do, Ready one Fuel.

cards.name: Rooster Nobody Can Catch
cards.flavor: Seven counties. Six warrants. Zero witnesses.

cards.name: Fireworks Technician
cards.text: Rotate, Sacrifice another of your Characters: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character.

cards.name: Patio-Table Prodigy
cards.text: Hothead.
cards.flavor: The patio set was still under warranty.

cards.name: Rabid Rat
cards.text: When this is Defeated, another of your Characters gets +2 Power this turn. If it is a Rat or Undead, it also gets +1 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Gym Selfie Guy
cards.flavor: Three sets. Forty-seven takes.

cards.name: Zombie Mall Walker
cards.text: When this is Defeated, you may Return it from your discard to your hand at the end of this turn.

cards.name: Guy Who Cut the Wrong Wire
cards.flavor: He remembers it as more of a group decision.

cards.name: Dumpster Phoenix
cards.text: Rotate, Sacrifice another of your Characters: Return a Character from your discard to your hand. If it is Undead, heal 2 damage from this.

cards.name: Stunt Clown
cards.text: Explosive.

cards.name: Backyard Wrestling Superfan
cards.text: Your other Wrestlers get +1 Power.

cards.name: Backyard Tag-Team Captain
cards.text: Rotate: Return another of your damaged Characters to your hand. If it was a Wrestler, Draw a card, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Rat in the Fireworks Box
cards.text: When this is Defeated, deal 1 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Guy Who Took the Chair Shot
cards.text: When this enters play, you may deal 1 damage to another of your Characters. If you do, Draw a card.

cards.name: Take One for the Team
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters. If you do, prevent the next 3 damage that would be dealt to your Leader this turn.

cards.name: This Seemed Like a Good Idea
cards.text: Choose two of your Characters. Sacrifice one of them. If you do, the other gets +2 Power and +2 Guard this turn.

cards.name: Worth It
cards.text: Choose one of your Characters and another Character. Sacrifice your chosen Character. If you do, deal damage equal to its last Power to the other chosen Character.

cards.name: Tag Me In!
cards.text: Return one of your damaged Characters to your hand. If you do, you may Play a different Character from your hand with equal or lower Cost without paying its Cost. If the returned Character was a Wrestler, the new Character gains Hothead this turn.
cards.flavor: I’ve got this. Please do not ask what “this” is.

cards.name: Again!
cards.text: Return a Character costing 2 or less from your discard to your hand.

cards.name: Sign the Waiver
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters. If you do, Draw 2 cards, then Discard a card.

cards.name: Light the Fuse
cards.text: Sacrifice one of your Characters to deal 2 damage to the opposing Leader.

cards.name: Keep It Going!
cards.text: If one of your Characters was Defeated during your Turn this turn, Ready one Fuel and Draw a card. You may Play only one Keep It Going! each turn.

cards.name: Bath Salts
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gains Undead. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this turn.

cards.name: Folding Chair
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. Dismiss this: The Character this was attached to gets +2 Power this turn, or +3 Power if it is a Wrestler.

cards.name: Definitely Safe Helmet
cards.text: Attach to one of your Characters. It gets +1 Guard. Rotate: Heal 1 damage from the attached Character.

cards.name: Button Marked DO NOT PRESS
cards.text: Rotate, Sacrifice one of your Characters: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character. This Item skips its next Ready step.
